programmes.d: Sabrina is excited when her father drops in for a visit. She's disappointed to find that her father has brought along with him his fiancie.
It's Salem's birthday and he's used to getting the lavish gifts. Sabrina thinks her homemade gift sucks so she time travels to get him a unique gift...
Gem hosts two exchange students to be cool. Instead of the real foreigners, Dawson and Felicity, show up instead. Psst! They are really mischievous faeries.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Happy Families
programmes.d: A problematic family beach picnic leads Don to end his relationship with Samantha, until Cleo encourages him to pursue it. Will's sister, Sophie, competes with Bella for a job at the café and sets her sights on Zane.

Rikki and Bella hide out at Cleo's to protect themselves from a full moon water attack. However, Bella is kidnapped by a water tentacle and taken to Mako Island. Lewis tries to keep Will away from the island so the girls can rescue her.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programmes.d: Cleo defies Lewis' advice and experiments with the magic Moon Pool water. Using her powers, Rikki accidentally gets the water into Cleo's aquarium and all the girls have to rescue Cleo's fish Hector.
Bella's warned to back off from Will as he's on the trail of the girls' mermaid secrets. She gets too close to him and he finally discovers she's a mermaid.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Just a Girl at Heart
programmes.d: Bella helps Will with his free-diving training but when she realises he's more interested in her as a mermaid than a girl, she's hurt. Rikki and Cleo have to improvise when the cafe's first corporate function is actually a children's party.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Crime and Punishment
programmes.d: Rikki receives counterfeit money at the café and is held captive by criminals on a boat. Bella and Cleo are forced to reveal the trio's secret to Will, so they can rescue Rikki together.

Unbeknownst to the boys, Cassy's been doing volunteer work before and after class, helping Dr. Mender, the resident bestial physician, tend to injured enchanted creatures. Cassy discovers she has a real gift for healing.
Class clown, Gus, is big on getting laughs. Cassy thinks she's just as funny and a competition begins.

Cassy is assigned to tend the school garden, where she discovers that the flowers are shrinking instead of growing. While trying to save a flower, she's yanked into “Rootopia,” – a bizarre underground realm.

After Samantha, Gus and Verne save a magical carpet from Zarlak, they've got to go back to their least favorite class at the Enchanted School -- Magical Histories, taught by their least favorite teacher -- the dull and boring Mr. Sternwand.

The girls discover a necklace for sale identical to Miss Chatham’s. Miriam causes a stir by buying it – then throwing it in the water. Rikki faces a choice whether to take the necklace and reveal her mermaidness to Zane.
Lewis thinks he’s found a way to control the girl’s mermaidness. The school dance brings all our heroines' 'boy issues' to the surface.
The return of Dr. Denman means trouble for the girls. Meanwhile, Emma is having family dramas of her own. With Zane’s unwitting help, Denman’s research at Mako Island uncovers the girls' secret!
Dr. Denman has discovered the girls' secret and trapped them on Mako Island. Their only chance to avoid being exposed is to use the lunar eclipse to give up their powers forever!
Under the influence of a Full Moon, the girls' powers are hugely enhanced and they wreak havoc on Lewis in his boat. The next day the girls realise they still need Lewis.
Emma uses her new powers to help Elliott win at soccer. Lewis decides to test the girls' increased powers. Cleo has had enough of Lewis' smothering and dumps him. Lewis meets Charlotte and they bond.
Simon and Marshall are cursed on Halloween by an odd occurrence involving Simon's little brother, the TV remote control, and a scary mummy movie.
Marshall uncovers a plot by a new school nurse, who's using an eye exam to hypnotize students to make them worker drones incapable of having fun.
Brothers Dwight and Stu are willing to do just about anything to come up with the money for a new P-11 Baja Sandslicer dirtbike, including stealing.
On a family picnic, brothers Rick and Teddy spend their time keeping three year-old sister Becky out of trouble, and waging war on a hill of ants with squirt guns and magnifying glasses.
Strict teacher Felix Purdy has always been tough on his students, particularly on introverted dreamer Daryl Kregman.
Young Randy is reluctant to accompany his Uncle Ned on a fishing trip / Delinquents Eddie and Herman have a bad habit of stealing parts for their hot rod from cars on the street.
When Sam's Uncle Paul, a caretaker at The Winchester Mystery House in San Diego, starts seeing ghosts, she must defend his sanity to save his job.
Rip, Sam, and Cyril travel to China, to photograph “Llama's Skull”, an artifact said to protect all those “in his vision”.
When the Golden Helmet of Ur is stolen from the BION HQ, Rip, Cyril, and Sam follow its tracking device to Kuwait City, in the Middle East.
When Rip's old college professor, Dr. Sullivan, searching the Amazon for a million-year-old dinosaur egg, falls ill, the BION team rush to South America.
On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh'lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers...
In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn't bargain for...
As everyone gears up for Battle Bladers, the crab-obsessed Tetsuya is up to his usual tricks defeating everyone - except Gingka.
Kenta befriends a new blader, Sora, who has amazing power but no control; Sora copies Gingka's special move, but cannot pull it off.
Gingka is pushed to the limits when he enters an important challenge match and faces a self-claimed magician named Ryutaro.
Four battles go on in four different stadiums as the competition heats up to make it into Battle Bladers.

Professor De La Porta kidnaps Dr. Jenkins and forces her to reveal the location of the powerful Primal Stones.
The theft of the Primal Stones upsets the island's environmental balance, triggering earthquakes, storms and volcanoes.
Sonic and Tails escape underground from Scratch and Grounder, but they are held captive there by a miserly mole named Spelunk.
One night, a bright, and glittering shopping mall mysteriously appears in Riverdale.
Government agents are convinced by Jughead's eccentric behavior that he is an advance scout for an alien invasion fleet.
Evil monsters from a virtual reality game break out and materialize in Riverdale!
Veronica doesn't think that Archie dotes on her enough, so she visits a witch woman who gives her a magic potion.

'The Inspector's Club': the Inspector accepts a challenge to solve the mystery of the mythical lost city of Atlantis. 'A Royal Pain': Bellhop Pinky stands in for a visiting 10-year-old king at a King's Convention and nearly starts World War III.

'Black & White & Pink All Over:' Detective Pinky agrees to locate a pesky little girl's doll. 'Beach Blanket Pinky': The Panther must rally the regulars at his favorite beach to defeat the Dogfather and company who have marked the beach as theirs.

'Digging For Dollars': The Inspector falls for a beautiful bank robber who uses a tunnel beneath his house to pull off her latest heist. 'Pinkocchio'' Lonely woodcarver Pink creates a little wooden boy whom he must then rescue from the Dogfather.

'Pinky Up The River': The Panther opens a river rafting operation only to encounter competition from Manly Man. 'Long John Pinky': The Panther gets shanghaied into being the cook aboard a pirate ship and must outsmart the dreaded Captain R. Gyle.

Scott's werewolf family comes to town for a family reunion. Scott's cousin, Eva, goes on a date with Mick, and it's Scott's responsibility to protect the family secret before it's revealed that Eva is a werewolf.
Pam's sheepdog, Daisy, gets loose and chases Ballard the cat. When Mr. Conroy is called to catch Daisy, he bumps into Grandpa, switches glasses with him, and takes him to the pound instead of Daisy.

His landlady smells a fish when Mr. Bean gets a bird. Sometimes Mr. Bean’s Teddy can be no fun at all. Feeling the need for a new friend, Bean buys a parrot. But getting the parrot past his landlady and her one-eyed cat, Scrapper.

Sunbathing proves a more strenuous pursuit for Mr. Bean. It’s a beautiful day at the beach. Bean breathes in the salty air, bliss - and not another soul in sight. What could possibly spoil his perfect day? Answer: British weather.

Mr. Bean forgets his teddy’s Birthday - then gives him a treat to remember. Mr. Bean is shocked when Teddy receives a birthday card from Bean’s girlfriend, Irma Gobb. The bear’s Birthday had completely slipped his mind.
Mr. Bean loses control of a pest and makes a mountain out of a molehill. Mr. Bean’s landlady is hopping mad on finding molehills on her lovely croquet lawn.
Uncle Quigley decides to reinstate Family Fun Night on Saturdays evenings! Sabrina and the Aunts think that Quigley is in serious need of a love life.
